empty.title: No inspections waiting for review
empty.body: No reviews in your scope are waiting for a decision.

unauthorized.title: You don’t have access to the review queue
unauthorized.body: This queue needs an allowed role — Admin, Planner, Supervisor, or assigned Inspector — with matching scope.

error.title: Review queue not available
error.body: We could not tell what state the reviews are in.

degraded.title: Some linked sources could not be read
degraded.body: The queue loaded, but one or more linked sources could not be read. Those details show as unavailable.

missingSla.title: Deadline settings missing
missingSla.body: No review deadline is configured. Rows show as unavailable instead of on time.

submissionBlocked.title: New submissions unavailable
submissionBlocked.body: New inspection submissions cannot be sent right now. Existing review records in your scope are still available.

readiness.noEvidenceBody: A linked source could not be read. It is not counted as ready.

ws.approveCompliance: Approval permanently locks this version and hands the approved inspection to the configured compliance chain. Penalty and document values are not invented here.
ws.approveWarnBody: locks the version, triggers compliance chain.
ws.audited: Audited: reviewer, reason, sections, prior/new status, version, timestamp.
ws.comment: Reviewer comment (cannot be changed once saved)
ws.commentPlaceholder: Optional comment, saved on its own and cannot be changed
ws.evidenceEmpty: No evidence records are attached to this submitted inspection.
ws.fvEmpty: No factory-field checks recorded for this inspection.
ws.fvError: Verification data is not available right now. We cannot show the source-versus-observed comparison yet.
ws.fvHeading: Factory data verification (Senaei source vs observed)
ws.fvNote: Observations never modify the Senaei source record; checks are audit-logged with before/after values.
ws.handoffUnavailable: Compliance handoff reference unavailable — the handoff is not confirmed.
ws.loadErrorDesc: We could not load the record. Something may be wrong with the data source. Try again.
ws.mediaPreviewUnavailable: We cannot show media files here because there is no allowed, safe link for them on this page. The details stay read-only, and the app does not show or guess a public link.
ws.notFoundDesc: No record matches this ID or it is outside your permitted scope.
ws.readOnlyBody: You cannot edit this content — the database blocks it (proven B3). To fix something, use Return with the exact scope.
ws.readOnlyNote: Read-only for this role — only Level 2 Reviewer / Operations can use the decision controls.
ws.rejectImpact: Reject is final, keeps the inspection read-only, and does not start Compliance Management. A new inspection requires a new visit.
ws.rejectWarnBody: no compliance trigger; new inspection needs a new visit.
ws.returnImpact: Return preserves this submitted version and unlocks only the selected sections for the assigned inspector.
ws.returnScopeHint: Only selected sections unlock; the rest stays locked.
ws.sigNone: No drawn signature stored with this version (acknowledged by name only).
ws.startBody: Opening this record does not change anything (CD-028). Starting the review claims it for you and moves the inspection to under review — an action we record.
ws.timelineNote: Submission, resubmission, review, comment, and Compliance handoff events from review_timeline().
ws.timelineUnavailableBody: The review timeline is not available in this environment. We do not make up a timeline to fill the gap.
ws.title: Review — {factory}

trace.empty: No checklist answers are available to build the trace chain.
trace.heading: Finding trace chain
trace.hint: Question → response → evidence → clause → violation → corrective action → decision comment. Each link is labelled by its source and version; unavailable links are never inferred.
trace.question: Question

ws.unauthBody: You need an allowed role — review, planning, operations, audit, leadership, or the assigned inspector — with matching scope, to open this review. Being visible in navigation does not mean you have access.
ws.unauthTitle: You don’t have access to this review

cmp.cleanBody: Every changed answer falls inside the returned sections. Non-answer comparisons remain unavailable below.
cmp.collectionUnavailable: Not available in one or both fixed snapshots — not treated as unchanged.
cmp.emptyDiff: No answer changed between these two versions (computed from stored snapshots — not a failure).
cmp.heading: Version comparison — Tamper-evident Scope Rail
cmp.navHint: Comparison is navigation-only — there is no accept/merge action. When a diff is shown, selecting a scope-rail row scrolls to its answer.
cmp.noPrior: No prior version to compare — this is the first submitted version.
cmp.noScope: No returned scope on record — expected/unexpected cannot be established, so changes are shown 'unavailable', never 'unchanged'.
cmp.scopeSource: Returned-scope authority (stored): {label}. Classification is never inferred from the diff.
cmp.sourceUnavailableBody: We could not load submitted-version data for this record, so we cannot show a comparison. This is not available, not an empty result.
cmp.staleBody: Version v{n} arrived while you had this open — refresh before relying on this comparison.
cmp.tamperBody: An answer changed outside the sections the reviewer returned. Read every flagged row before deciding.
cmp.unavailEvidence: Evidence / media comparison — not shown; marked not available, never 'unchanged'.
cmp.unavailHeading: Comparisons not derived in the runtime
cmp.unavailNote: These are honestly not available, not equal.
cmp.unavailPackage: Checklist-meaning comparison — we do not check whether an answer means the same thing across checklist versions.
